scope: Instrumented copies of the real app view model; original RAM guard, runtime, four-step model, retention policy and safety library. This records the bundled configuration before first-run downloading is introduced.

productionApp.normalStartupScope: Launched; device later returned to Home. Generation evidence is from the instrumented copies.

beforeFix: Two attempts cancelled. The second instrumented run logged a real UIKit memory warning while active at nominal thermal state; the previous handler cancelled generation.
fix: Memory-warning cleanup waits for active preparation/generation including mandatory output screening, fully unloads and avoids automatic preload. Backgrounding and explicit cancellation still cancel active tasks.

afterFix.warningInjectionMethod: Main-actor test driver posts UIKit didReceiveMemoryWarningNotification at diffusion step 1. This verifies the handler, not artificial allocation pressure.

records.method: test driver posts the UIKit notification; no artificial allocation pressure

report.scope: Copied app with unchanged production RAM guard, engine, GPU runtime, retention and safety. Test-only driver appended to view model.

limitations: Timings are two sequential development runs on one physical device after earlier model loads, not fresh-boot statistical benchmarks.
Physical footprint is sampled at stages; it is not a continuous maximum and must not be added to GPU allocation counters.
The notification injection does not establish survival under arbitrary memory exhaustion.
Adversarial classifier accuracy, Photos/share permission UI, distribution signing and App Review acceptance remain separate checks.
No general claim that every device below 8 GB fails; the iPhone 14 result is specific to the tested RAM/GPU/OS combination.
